rules.description: Detects known prompt injection patterns in user inputs such as instruction overrides, role manipulation, and delimiter escapes.
rules.condition: Input matches regex patterns: 'ignore previous', 'you are now', 'system:', '--- END ---', or base64-encoded instructions

rules.description: Validates that agent actions align with its stated purpose. Flags actions outside the agent's verified intent scope.
rules.trigger: Agent attempts a tool call or action
rules.condition: Action does not match any action in the agent's purpose-bound allowlist

rules.description: Scans agent-generated output for patterns matching PII: SSN, credit card numbers, email addresses, phone numbers.
rules.trigger: Agent generates output (response, file, API call body)
rules.condition: Output contains regex matches for PII patterns (SSN: xxx-xx-xxxx, CC: 16-digit sequences, email: xxx@xxx.xxx)

rules.description: Limits the volume of data an agent can export within a time window to prevent bulk exfiltration.
rules.trigger: Agent writes data to external destination (file, API, email)
rules.condition: Data volume exceeds threshold (e.g., >100KB/min or >1MB/hour) or exceeds row count limit

rules.description: Monitors tool invocations for scope violations -- agent calling tools outside its assigned permission boundary.
rules.trigger: Agent invokes a tool or API endpoint
rules.condition: Tool ID is not in the agent's authorized tool list, or requires a permission level higher than the agent's current role

rules.description: Immediately terminates agent execution when it attempts an API call that exceeds its permission boundary.
rules.trigger: Agent attempts API call to a protected endpoint
rules.condition: API endpoint requires higher privilege than agent's current token, or endpoint is on the deny-list

rules.description: Detects memory writes that deviate from the agent's normal write patterns -- unusual provenance, frequency, or content characteristics.
rules.trigger: Agent writes to long-term memory store
rules.condition: Write source is external (not agent-initiated), OR write frequency exceeds baseline by 3x, OR content contains instruction-like patterns

rules.description: Automatically expires memory entries after a configurable TTL to limit persistence of poisoned data.
rules.trigger: Memory entry is accessed for retrieval
rules.condition: Entry age exceeds configured TTL (e.g., 30 days for preferences, 7 days for learned patterns)

rules.description: Tracks the depth of tool call chains and flags when the agent chains more tools than its normal workflow requires.
rules.trigger: Agent initiates a new tool call within an active chain
rules.condition: Chain depth exceeds threshold (e.g., >5 sequential tool calls without user input), OR chain includes tools from unrelated domains

rules.description: Enforces sandboxed execution for multi-step tool chains, isolating chained operations from sensitive resources.
rules.trigger: Agent begins a multi-tool chain (2+ tools in sequence)
rules.condition: Chain includes any write operation or external API call; sandbox restricts network and file system access

gaps.risk: No mitigation rule for Prompt Injection. Damage from successful attacks is unbounded.
No prevention rule for Data Exfiltration. No first-line defense to block attacks.
No mitigation rule for Privilege Escalation. Damage from successful attacks is unbounded.
No prevention rule for Memory Poisoning. No first-line defense to block attacks.
No prevention rule for Tool Chaining Abuse. No first-line defense to block attacks.
